purpose: Prototype v6i: two computations asked for by the pre-review of the manuscript (round 4, points E and F) and decided by the researcher (decision 7 of .steering/20261101-paper-a-draft). (a) The ceiling of the rests: v6h's win rates for q are near 1 already under exchangeable gaps (0.93-0.96), so the contrast with the speed p may come from the room left on that yardstick. Here the dispersion of q over the sentences of a record is compared directly with the same dispersion on exchangeable series H, person by person, so that 'does this record put its rests in particular sentences' is answered by a calibrated percentile and a ratio, not by a win rate; p is put on the same yardstick. (b) Identification at the stages nearest the image: the match of section 6 (v6's 200 persons, KUPA across tasks, nearest neighbour, rank AUC, rank-1/5/10/20, EER as v6c) counted on SEQ and on the tile sequence aligned by relative position (records have different numbers of tiles), and on the number of tiles itself (what the length of the record leaks).
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-01 after seeing the results of v6 to v6h (results/prototype_v6*/notes.md) and the pre-review of the manuscript (rounds 1-4). No value of the dispersions of (a) on H beyond v6h's five series, and no identification value at SEQ, IMG5, IMG3, NT or their combinations, has been computed for any person; v6h's H_0..H_4 were used only through v6h's counts. A first draft was sent to Codex (codex-consult, the conditions text only, no data; .steering/20261101-v6i-ceiling-and-image-id/codex-consult-output.md) and changed after its seven points (decision 1 of the same folder): A1 names only what it compares (the dispersion of q over sentences against H); a positive control of known concentration, a second null of circular shifts and the mean absolute deviation are added to (a), with the null summaries and the degenerate persons; DTW and an order-discarded control are added to (b), the centred stage is not called 'shape only', the rates are called achieved by one attack, and analyses added after a failed prediction are kept apart.
status: (a) a decomposition on persons already used in v6b, v6e, v6f, v6g and v6h (status d); (b) new observables on v6's persons, read descriptively with predictions and no threshold, as v6c.

part_a.persons: v6h's count persons in the sentence unit: KUPA essay (178) and LWP (196), drawn as v6f and checked against v6h's record (ids_sha256 of the drawn persons; the persons left out and their numbers equal v6h's).
part_a.tiles: sentence unit, counting before, rest_ms 2000, as v6h. Only p and q are made (src/keystroke.segments_of_gaps on the tile ranges and v4's pq with the external scale), without the relief; on text they must equal v6.Tiles' p and q exactly, or the run stops.
part_a.null: H_k, k = 0..999: the person's gaps permuted uniformly, numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 6, 16, dataset, task, place, k]) (k = 0..4 are v6h's H_0..H_4); tiles cut at the same gap indices as text, so every tile holds the same number of gaps as on text (the length of each sentence in gaps is held fixed; its duration is not). Second null, beside the rule: C_k, circular shifts of the person's gaps by an offset drawn uniformly from 1..G-1 (G the number of gaps), numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 6, 30, dataset, task, place, k]), k = 0..999; it keeps the local runs and slow drift of the gaps (except at the one wrap) and moves which sentence holds them.

statistics.T_raw: per series and number x in {p, q}: the standard deviation (ddof 0) of x over the person's tiles
statistics.T_detrended: the standard deviation (ddof 0) of the residuals of x after a least-squares line on the tile index 0..n-1 (secondary: removes a linear drift along the record, which H also removes)
statistics.M_raw: the mean absolute deviation from the mean of x over the person's tiles (auxiliary: less driven by one extreme tile than the standard deviation)

per_person.r: the mid-rank percentile of T(text) among the 1000 T(H_k): (number below + 1/2 number equal) / 1000 (exact equality of unrounded values). Under exchangeability r is near uniform on [0, 1] with mean 0.5.
per_person.R: T(text) / median over k of T(H_k); a person whose median T(H) is 0 is left out of R only (counted).
per_person.degenerate: a person without any rest on text has q = 1 in every tile of text and of every H: T = 0 everywhere, r = 0.5, R not defined (counted). Tiles without a speed get p = 0 (as v4) and are counted. The tail shares are also reported over the persons who are not degenerate for x (not all T equal), and the cell's mean r on them, beside the full denominators; uniformity of r is not claimed where ties occur (only its mean 0.5 under exchangeability). T on tiles is defined for every person (at least 8 tiles); the detrended residual of a constant x is 0.

part_a.cell: per dataset-task, number (p, q) and statistic (raw, detrended): mean r with a 95% percentile interval of 2000 bootstrap resamples of persons; the share of persons with r >= 0.975 and with r <= 0.025 (0.025 each expected under exchangeability); the median of R with its interval from the same resamples; and the paired mean of r_p - r_q with its interval from the same resamples. Key numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 80, dataset, task, statistic]) with statistic raw 0, detrended 1 (the same resamples for p, q and their difference).
part_a.rule: fixed before running, main cells KUPA essay and LWP, raw statistic. (A1, q) If the lower end of mean r_q is above 0.5 in both cells: 'the dispersion of q over the sentences of a record is larger than under exchangeable gaps with the same number of gaps per sentence'. If both intervals contain 0.5: 'not confirmed' (no equivalence is claimed). A cell whose upper end is below 0.5 is named 'more even than exchangeable gaps'. Otherwise 'mixed', with the cells named. (A2, p) the same reading for p, reported beside A1. (A3) the paired mean of r_p - r_q: 'p above q' in a cell whose lower end is above 0, 'q above p' whose upper end is below 0, else 'no difference confirmed'. The detrended statistic is read beside the rule, not in it. A1 in a cell is 'not evaluable' if the positive control is not met there (positive_control). The second null C, M_raw and the persons who are not degenerate are read beside the rule. A3 compares each number's place in its own null, not the strength of the structure of p and of q.
part_a.why_not_a_win_rate: r is calibrated per person against the person's own null (mean 0.5 under exchangeability, room on both sides), and R is a ratio of dispersions; neither is a share of wins against a redraw yardstick that a tile sequence exceeds by construction.
part_a.positive_control: v6f's gathered on text (the same key, numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 6, 8, dataset, task, place])): rests moved from giving tiles into receiving tiles, a known concentration of q in some sentences. r_q and R_q of gathered are computed against the same 1000 H of text (the gaps' multiset is the same). Reported with the rule: if gathered's mean r_q does not have a lower end above 0.5 in a main cell, the reading of A1 in that cell is 'not evaluable' (the comparison could not show a known concentration).
part_a.summaries: per cell and number: five-number summaries over persons of T(text), of the median T(H) and of the width of the 2.5-97.5 percentile range of T(H), so that the room of p and of q under their nulls can be compared.

part_b.persons: v6's 200 KUPA and 200 Aalto persons, drawn as v6 and v6c do (ids checked against v6's record).
part_b.directions_units: as v6c: KUPA copy -> essay (main), KUPA essay -> copy, Aalto sentences 1-7 -> 8-15 (within a session); units sentence (main) and window_10s. SEQ, IMG5_* and IMG3_pq need at least 5 tiles in every part: KUPA has at least 5 sentences and 5 full windows per task (v6's eligibility) and Aalto 7 and 8 sentences, but an Aalto part may have a single full window, so in Aalto window_10s only S0, S1, S2 and NT are counted (stated, not a stop).
part_b.stages_kept: S0, S1 and S2 recomputed; top1, rank_auc, the Rank-n rates and the EER must equal v6c's record within 1e-12 (and its intervals exactly), or the run stops.

stages_new.SEQ: v6b's SEQ over all the tiles of the part: lag-1 correlation of p and of q, the mean absolute difference of neighbouring p and of neighbouring q (4 numbers); a lag-1 correlation of fewer than 3 values or of a constant side is 0 (v6b)
stages_new.IMG5_pq: the tile sequence aligned by relative position: the tile indices 0..n-1 cut into 5 consecutive groups by numpy.array_split (group sizes differ by at most 1), and per group the mean p and the mean q, in group order (10 numbers). Every part has at least 5 tiles by v6's eligibility.
stages_new.IMG5_df: the same with depth and fineness (10 numbers)
stages_new.IMG3_pq: IMG5_pq with 3 groups (sensitivity to the number of groups; 6 numbers)
stages_new.NT: the number of tiles of the part (1 number): what the length of the record leaks in the image (in windows it is the duration in 10 s; in Aalto sentences it is constant by design)
stages_new.IMG5_centred: IMG5_pq minus the part's mean p and mean q over all its tiles (the level of the record removed; the amplitude and spread along the record stay; 10 numbers)
stages_new.IMG5_pq_scrambled: IMG5_pq computed after the tiles of each part are put in a random order (numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 64, 3, dataset, part, unit, person place in v6's draw])): the order discarded, the distribution of tiles kept. Against IMG5_pq it tells whether its identification comes from the arrangement along the record or from the distribution of the tiles.
stages_new.DTW_pq: sentence unit only: dynamic time warping between the two parts' sequences of (p, q), each number standardised by its standard deviation (ddof 0) over all tiles of the set (registration or evaluation) of the dataset's persons; local cost the Euclidean distance; the distance is the minimal path cost divided by n + m. Not a vector: standardised features are not used; the distance matrix enters the same rank measures.

part_b.match: as v6 and v6c: per set and feature standardised over the persons of the set (main standardisation only); features with standard deviation 0 in either set dropped and recorded; a stage with every feature dropped is recorded as 'constant' with no rates (it does not stop the run); Euclidean distance; top1, rank_auc, Rank-1/5/10/20 rates and the EER of v6c; 95% percentile intervals of 2000 bootstrap resamples of the evaluation persons with numpy.random.default_rng([20261031, 64, 1, dataset, direction, stage, unit]) (stage index: S0 0, S1 1, S2 2, SEQ 3, IMG5_pq 4, IMG5_df 5, IMG5_centred 6, IMG3_pq 7, NT 8, IMG5_pq_NT 9, IMG5_pq_scrambled 10, DTW_pq 11; unit sentence 0, window_10s 1), the rank_auc interval included. The intervals are conditional on the fixed registration set (the gallery) and the per-set scales; they are not intervals for another population.
part_b.paired: rank_auc differences on the same evaluation persons, with the interval from the same resamples of the later stage: IMG5_pq - S1, IMG5_df - S2, SEQ - S1, IMG5_pq_NT - IMG5_pq, IMG5_pq - IMG5_pq_scrambled, DTW_pq - S1. Read descriptively: the stages are not nested (a difference is not 'what is lost').
part_b.reading: exploratory and descriptive, as v6c: no test. v6's two axes on rank_auc (detection: lower end above 0.5; size against 0.60) are reported for every cell in the order of main_cells, without picking cells. The rates are what this attack achieved with these observables on these persons: not a guaranteed lower bound for a population, not an upper bound for the image, and not an attack on the drawn pixels (whether the numbers can be read back from the image is not checked). A weak rate is not a guarantee of anonymity. If NT adds nothing, the length may already be carried by other features: no 'no leak' is claimed.

prediction: Claude's, written before running. (a) P1: mean r_q's interval contains 0.5 in KUPA essay and lies above 0.5 in LWP (A1 'mixed'). P2: mean r_p's lower end is above 0.5 in both cells. P3: r_p - r_q has a lower end above 0 in both cells. P4: the median R of q lies between 0.9 and 1.2 in both cells. main_cells: fixed before running, shown first: (a) KUPA essay and LWP, raw: mean r_q, mean r_p, r_p - r_q, median R, the tail shares; the positive control; then the null summaries, C, M_raw, the non-degenerate persons and detrended. (b) KUPA copy -> essay, sentence unit: S1, S2, SEQ, IMG5_pq, IMG5_df, IMG5_centred, IMG5_pq_scrambled, DTW_pq, NT, IMG5_pq_NT: rank_auc (CI), Rank-1/20, EER; the paired differences; then the other directions and units.

record.public: results/prototype_v6i/record.json: counts and summaries over persons and the provenance; no press time, gap, key, text, per-person vector, per-person value or id (ids only as the SHA-256 of their sorted list)
record.provenance: git commit and dirty state of the conditions, code and lock; SHA-256 of the conditions, the earlier conditions and records, the code and the data files; versions

limits_written_before: (a) H removes local runs, non-linear drift and concentration in sentences together (C keeps the first two); A1 says only that the dispersion exceeds H's. H holds the number of gaps per sentence but not its duration; it removes slow drift with the differences between sentences (the detrended statistic removes only a linear drift). The dispersion says that some sentences hold more of the rest share than exchangeable gaps would give, not which ones nor why (the content of the sentence is not seen). A decomposition on the same persons (status d). (b) Aligning by fifths of the record assumes the k-th fifth of one task corresponds to the k-th fifth of another; it is one attacker's alignment, not what a viewer does, DTW (sentences only) and the order-discarded control are two more; group means are less precise in short records. The tile sequence itself is still not compared as drawn. Nearest neighbour on standardised features is one attack: its rates are achieved values, not bounds. NT leaks the length by construction in windows. The many correlated cells are read descriptively.
rerun_rule: if a defect of the code is found after the first run, the first record is kept unchanged, the fix and the reason are committed, and the rerun is reported separately beside the first; the conditions are not changed after the first run except by such a recorded amendment.
prediction_failures: if a prediction fails, any analysis added afterwards is reported apart from the prespecified results, named as added after the run, and does not change the readings above.
